results.title: Egypt coach Hossam Hassan confirms Salah ready, hails Brazil friendly as World Cup test – UAE Journal
highlights:
Hassan confirmed that Mohamed Salah is now fit and available for competitive fixtures after completing a targeted rehabilitation program. The forward’s conditioning was managed jointly with Liverpool before final work with the national team’s medical staff, and Hassan expressed confidence in his readiness.
[...]
Injury worries: Islam Issa and Mohamed Hamdy sidelined
[...]
Egypt will miss the services of Islam Issa and Mohamed Hamdy in the immediate term owing to injury concerns, Hassan confirmed. Both players are undergoing treatment and the medical team is optimistic about their prospects for recovery prior to the tournament if rehabilitation progresses smoothly.
[...]
Hassan said the squad has depth in several positions, but acknowledged the absences remove important tactical options. The coach reiterated that any replacement decisions will reflect the tactical balance required for each upcoming opponent.

results.title: Egypt coach Hossam Hassan gives positive update on Mohamed Salah - Football | Tribuna.com
highlights:
# Egypt coach Hossam Hassan gives positive update on Mohamed Salah
[...]
Egypt head coach Hossam Hassan has provided an update on Mohamed Salah’s fitness ahead of the 2026 World Cup, insisting the Liverpool star is ready for action after completing his rehabilitation programme.
[...]
Salah recently recovered from a hamstring injury suffered in May against Crystal Palace, though he has gradually returned to match action in both club and international fixtures.
[...]
“Salah completed his rehabilitation programme at Liverpool and then with the national team, and now he is ready for matches,” Hassan said.
[...]
The Egypt coach also acknowledged the difficulty of their World Cup group, with the opening match against Belgium expected to be a major test.
[...]
“The first match against Belgium at the World Cup will be extremely difficult, and our group is strong and very competitive,” he added.
[...]
Salah has featured sparingly since his return from injury, playing just 45 minutes across two matches for Egypt, including a substitute appearance against Brazil and missing the game against Russia.
[...]
Egypt have been drawn in Group G alongside Belgium, Iran and New Zealand, with their opening fixture against Belgium scheduled for June 15.

# Aqtay out as Egypt announce final squad for World Cup
[...]
Egypt coach Hossam Hassan announced early on Saturday the final 26-man squad that will participate in the anticipated 2026 World Cup finals next month.
[...]
On 21 May, Hassan announced a preliminary 27-man squad ahead of playing the friendly game against Russia; with only one player will be excluded after the game.
[...]
Enppi SC forward Aqtay Abdallah, who received his first senior call-up in the preliminary squad, was omitted by Hassan in Saturday’s final squad.
[...]

results.title: Hossam Hassan Confirms Egypt Final World Cup Squad - KingFut
highlights:
Hossam Hassan has named the final 26-man squad for Egypt to travel to the FIFA World Cup after trimming the initial provisional list.
[...]
Hossam Hassan has announced Egypt’s final 26-man squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, cutting one player from the provisional roster he named ahead of the Russia friendly.
[...]
The final list includes Mohamed Salah, Omar Marmoush, Mahmoud Hassan Trezeguet, Emam Ashour, Mohamed El Shenawy, Mohamed Abdelmonem and Barcelona youth forward Hamza Abdelkarim. Oktay Abdallah dropped out of the squad after joining the preliminary list.
[...]
Egypt’s goalkeepers are Mohamed El Shenawy, Mostafa Shobeir, El Mahdy Soliman and Mohamed Alaa.
[...]
The defensive list includes Mohamed Hany, Tarek El Ashraf, Hamdi Fathy, Ramy Rabia, Yasser Ibrahim, Hossam Abdelmaguid, Mohamed Abdelmonem and Ahmed Fatouh.
[...]
Hassan also selected Marwan Attia, Ahmed Nabil Kouka, Nabil Emad Donga, Ahmed Sayed Zizo, Nasser Maher, Emam Ashour, Ibrahim Adel, Mohamed Salah, Trezeguet, Omar Marmoush and Mohamed Shehata in midfield.
[...]
The attacking line includes Mostafa Fathi, Osama Faisal and Hamza Abdelkarim, who earned a senior call-up before making his World Cup debut at senior international level.
[...]
Egypt will continue their preparations before travelling to their World Cup base. The Pharaohs are due to play Brazil in Cleveland on June 6 before opening their Group G campaign.
